tools.description: Use this when a user asks to audit, check or test the accessibility of a website or web page (WCAG, a11y, RGAA, ADA or European Accessibility Act checks), for example their home page, a product page, the cart or a form. tools.name: check_eaa_scope
tools.description: Use this when a user asks whether the European Accessibility Act (EAA, Directive (EU) 2019/882, « acte européen sur l'accessibilité ») applies to their business or website, for example an online shop, a bank or a transport operator. It applies since 28 June 2025. Checks the covered consumer services
